seat:ForCurrentElement:0: The last [gold]Pyro[/gold], [gold]Hydro[/gold], [gold]Cryo[/gold] or [gold]Electro[/gold] you applied. Swirls pay it: [gold]Pyro[/gold]
seat:ForDrain:0: Lose N HP. Each combat, the first 1/4 of your Max HP drained returns after combat. That is your line: past it, only [gold]Repay[/gold] returns.
seat:ForElementalReaction:0: An element meets another element's aura on an enemy. The aura is consumed and the pair's effect happens.
seat:ForEmptyField:0: No [gold]Bomb[/gold] on the field: this card does nothing.
seat:ForEmptyField:1: No [gold]Bomb[/gold] on the field: this card is only its own line.
seat:ForFanfare:0: Gain 1 for each HP you lose, [gold]Drain[/gold] included, or [gold]Repay[/gold]. [gold]Spend[/gold] uses it. Resets after each combat.
seat:ForFinalBowInTurn:0: Its acts happen one after another, not all at once.
seat:ForFlip:0: Turn this card to its other face. It starts each combat on Ousia.
seat:ForGuestStar:0: Exhausts. Acts at the end of your turn. When it leaves, this card goes to your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
seat:ForKnight:0: One of Varka's Companions. Playing one makes its element your current element. [gold]Geo[/gold] does not.
seat:ForLightfallSword:0: A blade hung over an enemy. Its badge counts down the turns until it falls.
seat:ForLionsFangLastTurn:0: Mines that go off on the enemies' turn count too.
seat:ForMend:0: [gold]Mend N[/gold]: heal N HP, but never above the HP you had at the start of this combat.
seat:ForMine:0: A [gold]Bomb[/gold] that also goes off by itself when its enemy attacks you, using up the enemy's aura. The enemy's other Bombs stay.
seat:ForNereidsTwice:0: Twice means twice: the [gold]Plan[/gold]'s debuffs, and any Tainted it causes, double too. A [gold]Plan[/gold] carried out early is carried out once.
seat:ForOath:0: 1 Oath per element a card applies, plus 1 per element it [gold]Swirls[/gold]. Kept all fight. Element cards read their own, others the current.
seat:ForOldestGuest:0: The guest on stage longest: the one the next summon on a full stage would remove.
seat:ForOz:0: Fischl's raven. While you hold Oz, at Your Side, he makes an [gold]Electro[/gold] hit at the end of your turn.
seat:ForPassTheMatchActing:0: Choose a player who has not ended their turn. If they have, it does nothing.
seat:ForPlan:0: Play it on the [gold]Bake-Kurage[/gold] instead. After enemies act and you draw, Plans happen in order; [gold]Block[/gold] lasts that turn. Click one to flip it.
seat:ForPlanElement:0: The [gold]Bake-Kurage[/gold] carries out this [gold]Plan[/gold] as a [gold]Hydro[/gold] hit: it applies [gold]Hydro[/gold].
seat:ForPlanNoLine:0: A card with a Plan line can be played on the [gold]Bake-Kurage[/gold] to happen next turn. This card has no Plan line.
seat:ForPlanOnly:0: Play the card on the [gold]Bake-Kurage[/gold]. Plans happen next turn in order, and their [gold]Block[/gold] lasts that turn.
seat:ForPlanTwice:0: A [gold]Plan[/gold] carried out twice counts as two. Every clause that counts [gold]Plans[/gold] carried out pays for both.
seat:ForRepay:0: Regain that much drained HP. A Repay counts only the HP it returns. Any HP a Repay cannot return becomes [gold]Block[/gold].
seat:ForSakura:1: A totem that stays at your side all combat. At most 3 fire each turn.
seat:ForSetOff:0: Every [gold]Bomb[/gold] on the enemy goes off, oldest first. Bombs on other enemies stay. A random Set off picks an enemy with Bombs.
seat:ForSpend:0: Pay that much [gold]Fanfare[/gold]. With less, you cannot play the card or its Spend mode. Spend up to X pays X, or all you have if that is less.
seat:ForSummon:0: A guest joins at the back. On a full stage, the oldest guest acts once and leaves; its card goes to your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
seat:ForSwirl:0: [gold]Anemo[/gold] meets an aura: remove it, deal
seat:ForSwirl:1: unblockable damage to ALL enemies, and apply that element to the others.
seatspark:False: Some cards cost [gold]Sparks[/gold] instead of Energy, with no cap. Gone after combat.
seatspark:True: Some cards cost [gold]Sparks[/gold] instead of Energy, with no cap. Start each combat with 3. Gone after combat.

static:YaeEditTip: Give a card an Annotation for this combat, replacing its last. Published ones stay and add up.
static:YaeFoxfireSakuraTip: A [gold]Sakura[/gold] that deals damage equal to 1 plus its Level to ALL enemies when it acts.
static:YaeFullShrineTip: Planting makes the Sakura closest to withering act. Same kind: it refreshes and gains a Level. Other kind: it withers, and the new one takes its Level if higher.
static:YaeKitsuneSakuraTip: A fox decoy [gold]Sakura[/gold]. When it acts, you gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to 2 plus its Level.
static:YaeSakuraTargetRule: A Sakura strikes Kitsune Pounce's target when Pounce makes it strike, else the enemy Foxfire Lure marked this turn, else (with Hunting Gaze) the last enemy your Attacks hit, else a random enemy.
static:YaeSakuraTip: At the end of your turn, deals 1 damage plus 2 for each Level. Lasts 3 turns, then strikes again.
static:YaeTenkoTip: Every [gold]Sakura[/gold] acts now and goes back to at least 3 turns left.
